description: This is a classic, single-seater armchair upholstered in rich, dark brown leather. It features a robust design with comfortably rolled arms and a plush, inviting appearance. The upholstery is accentuated by prominent white contrast stitching, outlining the edges of the removable seat cushion and the distinctive curves of the backrest. A striking detail is the decorative nailhead trim (studs), which runs along the front edge of the arms and the base of the chair, adding a touch of traditional elegance and craftsmanship. The chair stands on four sturdy, short, dark-colored turned wooden legs. Its overall aesthetic combines comfort with a sophisticated, timeless appeal.
